test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Send these books to my new address.

options.text: These books should have been sent to my new address.
Let these books be sent to my new address.
These books must be send to my new address.
These books are being sent to my new address.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Let these books be sent to my new address**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and it is in the present simple tense.
 
• The active format "V1 (send)" should be converted into the passive format "be + V3 (sent)".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the present simple tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
